description: Two multiplier sections added into one output, each multiplying its own knob, its IN1 voltage and its IN2 voltage together

params.text: Scales one section of the sum, -8 to +8; that section contributes this figure times its IN1 voltage times its IN2 voltage

inputs.text: One of the two voltages multiplied together in that section; with nothing patched it counts as 1, leaving that section as its knob times its IN2
One of the two voltages multiplied together in that section; with nothing patched it reads 0V, which empties that section from the sum

notes: the output stays at 0V until something is patched into an IN2 jack, because an unpatched IN2 reads 0V and empties its section from the sum
the module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and the output carries one channel

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 1, a bare number rather than a voltage.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 1, a bare number rather than a voltage.
